ads.h2: Google Ads: what every $1 brought back
ads.intro: Five restaurant ad accounts we managed in 2025, best return first.
ads.roasLineHtml: How to read it: ROAS (return on ad spend) is what came back for every $1 of ads. 72:1 means about $72 in bookings and inquiries tracked by Google for each $1 spent. A conversion is one tracked action, like a reservation, a call or a private-event inquiry.

totals.reviewNote: these portfolio totals do not reconcile with the five accounts above (together they add up to 2,619 conversions and about $1.1M in conversion value; under $46K of spend at $8 per booking would be about 5,750 bookings, not 45,000+). Confirm how 45,000+, $8 and $3.5M are counted before launch.

ads.disclaimer: Figures are from restaurant ad accounts we managed in 2025. Individual results vary, and past performance does not guarantee future results.

web.intro: Custom-coded sites, designed for the phone first. No templates.

cta.body: Book a free 30-minute strategy call. You talk to Juan, our founder, not a sales rep. We look at where your restaurant stands and the moves that fill seats, and you keep the plan either way.

quote.text: As a local restaurant owner with a few spots here I love supporting small businesses, and having used other marketing agencies before I can see the value right away.
